in_marathi.name: Padmika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Padmika is derived from the lotus flower. It symbolizes divine beauty, purity, and prosperity. The name is believed to bestow upon the child a graceful and elegant demeanor.

vedic_reference.note: The name Padmika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma', which means lotus. It is believed that the goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity, resides in the lotus flower. The name Padmika is a beautiful and meaningful name that symbolizes purity, beauty, and prosperity.
